[SWS_SM_00677] ErrorCode for failed termination of a StateMachine of type
Agent
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005
⌈
If the
StateMachine
of type
Controller
detects an error during destruction of
a
StateMachine
of type
Agent
, the configured
stopAgentError
mapped to the
affected
StateMachine
shall be used as ErrorCode in the
Controller Error-
RecoveryTable
.
⌋
